## Samsung — RAG Retrieval Smoke Test (Phase 3B)

A **smoke test only**, not the 21-case evaluation dataset (`evaluation/retrieval_cases.json`) — that stays unrun until a future, explicitly approved phase.

Embeds one hand-written query via the same OpenAI credential as `Samsung — RAG Indexing`, then calls the existing `match_product_chunks()` Postgres function (db/migrations/005_functions.sql, unmodified) directly. Verifies only that a real text query, through a real embedding, retrieves the expected already-indexed product/chunks — not retrieval quality or ranking tuning.

assignments.name: query_text
assignments.value: OLED телевизор с хорошим игровым режимом для PS5 и мощным звуком для фильмов, без отдельного саундбара

parameters.query:
SELECT
  chunk_id,
  product_id,
  document_id,
  similarity,
  left(content, 200) AS content_preview,
  metadata->>'section' AS section,
  metadata->>'model_code' AS model_code
FROM match_product_chunks('{{ $json.embedding_literal }}'::vector, {{ $json.match_count }});
